Anjali Qureshi · anjali.qureshi840@example.com · +91 9585780814
Koramangala, Bengaluru, India

Professional Summary
Frontend developer focused on building scalable, testable Angular applications. Strong TypeScript and component-driven development skills with experience applying Jest for unit testing, CSS for responsive UI, and Agile workflows tracked in Jira. Notice period: 60 days.

Technical Skills
Angular, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, Jest, Jira, Agile, Git

Work Experience

Angular Developer, Pixelwave Studios (Feb 2023 - Present)
- Implemented modular Angular feature modules and reusable components using TypeScript and Angular, reducing duplicate UI code by 35% while improving load times for key pages.
- Built responsive layouts and custom CSS utilities to support cross-device compatibility, increasing mobile user retention on targeted flows.
- Created and maintained Jest unit tests for critical components and services, achieving and maintaining >80% component test coverage across core modules.
- Collaborated in Agile sprints via Jira and used Git for feature branching and pull request workflows to deliver biweekly releases.

Angular Developer, Razorpay (Nov 2020 - Jan 2023)
- Developed payment UI components and checkout flows using Angular and TypeScript, optimizing render performance and lowering perceived latency on checkout by measurable amounts.
- Coded semantic HTML and styled components with CSS to meet accessibility and responsive design requirements for multiple merchant integrations.
- Wrote and maintained Jest unit tests for components and utility services, enabling faster CI feedback and reducing regressions in payment flows.
- Participated in Agile ceremonies tracked in Jira and managed source code with Git for coordinated releases across cross-functional teams.

Education
BBA, Christ University
